(historical) A member of the Nazi Party (the National Socialist German Workers' Party or NSDAP).
x: After World War II, many Nazis fled to South American countries like Argentina and Chile to escape prosecution.

s.d: (colloquial) A person associated with Nazi Germany.
x: Our city was occupied by Nazis during World War II.

s.d: (colloquial) One who advocates neo-Nazism.
(derogatory, offensive, slang) One who imposes their views on others; one who is unfairly oppressive or needlessly strict. (also frequently uncapitalised: nazi)
x: She's a total grammar Nazi.

s.d: (historical) Of or pertaining to the Nazi Party specifically, or to Nazism, neo-Nazism, or neo-Nazis more generally.
